events.title: Telegram
events.text:
🇷🇺 Russia’s Geran-5 drone closes in on record 800 km/h - nears cruise missile speed
Russia’s jet-powered Geran-5 attack drones used in recent strikes on [Ukraine’s military-linked targets](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/76171) has reached speeds nearing 800 km/h, according to air-monitoring data circulating online.
👉 Previous estimates put the speed maximum at around 600 km/h. 
Russia has either upgraded existing models or fielded a new varia[nt still listed under the Geran-5 designation](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/75584), analysts speculate.
🔶 speed increase means less time to detect drone threat, pass targeting data, and launch interceptors
🔶 countering made especially difficult for mobile fire teams & units optimized against slower UAVs
🔶 at roughly 800 km/h, the drone approaches the performance of some subsonic air-launched cruise missiles like [Russia’s Kh-101 ](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/72880)
🔶 it retains lower cost and mass-production potential of an unmanned system
Russia has progressively upgraded[ the Geran family with improved navigation](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/74638), electronic warfare resistance and greater performance.
The Geran-5 model: 
🔴 uses a turbojet engine, unlike earlier piston-engine models
🔴 can carry a warhead weighing up to 90 kg
🔴 has an estimated operational range of ~1,000 km
🔴 at ~ 6 meters long, it uses cruise missile-style configuration rather than flying-wing design

events.text:
🤥💰Trump’s ballroom bonanza: Secret donors & lucrative government deals 
The total of $333M has already been pledged toward Donald Trump’s planned White House ballroom, with at least $77 million coming from donors seeking anonymity, reported The Washington Post.
An internal spreadsheet includes 67 donations above $10,000 recorded as of late September.
While ordinary political giving follows campaign-finance law, this money flows through a nonprofit to the government - and into a White House account the president controls. 
♦️ $166.1M came from the tech industry, with Nvidia and Apple each committing $25M
♦️ Nvidia reportedly requested its donation - made after it reached a[ deal with the Trump administration to sell its microchips to China](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/60839) - be kept anonymous
♦️ US-Israeli citizen and Trump [megadonor Miriam Adelson also pledged $25M](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/68548)
♦️ [Lockheed Martin, Microsoft and Palantir each gave $10M; ](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/74041)Amazon, Comcast, Caterpillar are also among major donors
♦️ crypto firms operating amid [Trump-relaxed regulation,](https://t.me/geopolitics_prime/61436) pledged over $18M 
Some donations followed government decisions affecting donors’ businesses. 
🔴 an affiliate of Rocket mortgage lender pledged $10M after the federal approval of housing acquisitions
🔴 Salesforce committed money after securing a hefty army contract 
🔴 tech billionaire and EchoStar cofounder Charles Ergen pledged $25M after regulators dropped a probe into his company 
🔴 Isabela Herrera pledged $2.5M after her father Julio Herrera Velutini, a Venezuelan-Italian banker indicted for bribery, secured a plea deal 
The fundraising has yet to meet Trump’s $400M target.
